metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Nimeron Logistics (freight and logistics); Platform: Google Cloud asia-south1 (zones asia-south1-a/asia-south1-b/asia-south1-c); network range 10.172.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster nimero-prod-asiaso (GKE); Identity/token service auth-svc is called synchronously by every API request and is backed by PostgreSQL auth-db-01; deployments may bundle database migrations; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: Which service or infrastructure component did the incident originate in?
What is the identifier of the change that caused the incident?
Which account or automation identity executed the triggering change?
Which database index removal caused the slowdown?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Did the failure stay isolated to one component or cascade across services? Answer 'isolated failure' or 'cascading failure'.
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change happened shortly before the incident began but did not cause it? Provide its identifier.
